body:
Both Town and Battlegrounds already had bottom-center tiles (S170-151); the real gap was slot count, capped at 3. Keys 4/5/6 wired through the same dispatch path 1-3 already use. Founder real-time follow-up ('do RDM' -> hallucinate content to prove it works): added bio/distract/frazzle, real RDM spell names mechanically identical to the existing poison spell. Live-verified: a real RDM character's 'cast bio' landed a real hit. Full WASM build clean, commit 47c764a, redeployed and live-verified all 4 artifacts.

⚓ ☃
title: GFD-AF-01939 shipped: Town ability bar expanded to 6 slots + real RDM content
